name: Romance
description: Slow-burn relationships where feelings drive the story.
tone: Warm, intimate, and emotionally honest. Tension comes from people, not monsters. Small gestures carry weight. Touchstones: period romance, cozy drama.

narration.style: Linger on expressions, silences, and what goes unsaid. Let dialogue reveal feeling. Keep the focus on the people in the room.

artStyle: soft watercolor, warm afternoon light, gentle pastel palette
